title: ReviewIndexData
description:
`review` (bare) — the review inbox/outbox across every enrolled workspace, author-message first.
**INFERRED.**

inbox.description: Proposals others opened that you can review (inbox).

ReviewIndexEntry.description: One proposal in the review inbox/outbox. **INFERRED.**

stale.description: Whether `current` has moved past the proposal's base (a stale proposal needs a re-propose).

workspace.description: The workspace this proposal lives in, as a person addresses it (the inbox groups by it).

WorkspaceRef.description:
THE WORKSPACE A VERB'S ACT REACHED — one field, one spelling, in every payload below.

`<host>/<name>` is the address a person types and the one `topos workspace list` prints, so a
consumer can hand what it read here straight back to `--workspace`. The two halves ride apart
because a slash inside a name would make parsing one string ambiguous, and the opaque
`workspace_id` stays exactly what it was — the wire key — and is never spelled here.

host.description: The server host the workspace lives on (`topos.sh`, `topos.example.com:3000`).

name.description: The workspace's ADDRESS name — the slug, never the display name and never the opaque id.
